name: Kichiji Nobutaka
source: Nobutaka Kichiji is the master of the Kichiji clan, represented by Oshu merchants. He was asked by Hidehira to bring Yoshitsune to Hiraizumi. Usually unfussy, strict about business and is a little overprotective uncle for the hero.
